title: fix(components,types): eight renderers stop reading undeclared node keys; input-otp and loading read their declared spellings (objectui#11347)
body:
Refs #11347
Clause-②: yes (narrowing)

This PR is the `@object-ui/components` preparation unit of objectui#8347. objectui#8347 is the parent: it removes `BaseSchema`'s index signature, and it lands last. This PR settles the twelve un-cast reads in eight renderers that objectui#8347's P1 mutation reddens, measuring each key on its own:
- Seven reads are retired.
- Two move to the spelling the type already declares.
- One key, `list.title` (two reads), is kept and declared.

The Clause-② arm covers both directions:
- The retirements narrow the registry's `inputs` and the keys the renderers honour.
- The `ListSchema.title` declaration widens the TypeScript face. On the zod mirror it newly refuses a non-string `title`.

64 of the package's 94 test errors are retyped to their concrete node types. The other 30 stay:
- One is objectui#8347's own probe flip.
- The other 29 author nodes with no TypeScript declaration at all. The seat moved them to objectui#11364. That is why this PR says `Refs`.

**Round 2** answers the at-tier record (FAIL, one item) and the seat's ruling on the card. My census missed a producer of `list.title`: the published `skills/objectui` expressions guide (`guides/schema-expressions.md`, under `os:check`). It authors `{ "type": "list", "title": "Team", ... }`, and it says `title` is read off the node. Under the card's rule 2 the seat ruled to keep the read and declare the key, by 「未声明键随实现,文档随之」. `list` has no spec row, the renderer reads `title`, and the registration publishes it. Nothing under `skills/` changes.

This body was refreshed at 2026-10-01T09:41Z. It answers every comment posted on this PR since the first body:
- the at-tier record `5927953448`, in this section;
- the `changeset-claim-re-read` comment `5927656616`, under **Files outside the claimed surface** and **Gates**;
- three Console Performance Budget comments (`5927699774`, `5928383897`, `5928726380`). They report PASS and ask nothing.

## Per-key verdicts

**Spec row.** The installed `@objectstack/spec` is 17.5.0. Its `ComponentPropsMap` has 55 entries, and none of them is any of the eight node types. A grep of the whole installed package for `shouldScaleBackground`, `showClose`, `input-otp` and `dropdown-menu` returns zero hits. The control `modalCloseButton` hits three files, so the grep was reading.

**Producers.** The census covered:
- `examples/schema-catalog`, every entry of these eight node types, key by key;
- `examples/*` and `content/docs/**`;
- every package README;
- `packages/types/examples`;
- `skills/`;
- objectstack `origin/main` `2742e5370`, its examples and packages.

**One producer exists: the `skills/objectui` expressions guide authors `title` on a `list` node.** This was missed in round 1 and caught by the at-tier record. None of the producers authors any of the other eight read keys. The objectstack hits for `type: 'list'` and `type: 'drawer'` are page types, flow variables and a form-view type, not component nodes. The registrations name these keys in their own `inputs` / `defaultProps`. None of the eight types is in `PUBLIC_BLOCKS`, so those names never reach the published `sdui.manifest.json`.

**Runtime.** Each key was rendered through the real `SchemaRenderer` and registry, before and after, in a scratch probe that is not committed.

| node | key (reads) | rule | verdict | rendered through `SchemaRenderer`, before then after |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `list` | `title` (2) | 2: a producer authors it | **kept, declared** as `ListSchema.title?: string` on both faces | a heading with the title, both before and after; now pinned |
| `loading` | `text` (2) | 3, near spelling | read moves to the declared `LoadingSchema.label`; `text` retired with no alias | `text`: a message, then none. `label`: none, then a message |
| `input-otp` | `maxLength` (TS2551) | 3, near spelling | read moves to the declared `InputOTPSchema.length` | `length: 4`: 6 slots, then 4. `length: 8`: 6, then 8. `maxLength: 4`: 4, then 6 |
| `sidebar-menu-button` | `active` (read off `BaseSchema` itself; no node type exists) | 3 | retired | `data-active="true"`, then `"false"` |
| `drawer` | `footer` | 3 | retired | the footer is drawn, then none |
| `drawer` | `showClose` | 3 | retired | 1 Close button, then 0 |
| `drawer` | `shouldScaleBackground` | 3 | named read retired | the vaul root receives the authored `false` both before and after, through the prop spread |
| `dropdown-menu`, `popover`, `sheet` | `modal` (1 each) | 3 | named read retired | the Radix root receives the authored value both before and after, through the prop spread |

`list.title` is declared on both faces at once, so no `zod-mirror-parity` row opens. A non-string `title` that `.passthrough()` used to keep unjudged is now refused at `title`. That follows the `wrapperClass` precedent from objectui#7722.

**H3: the near spellings.** For `input-otp`, all five catalog entries and the docs page spell the key `length`. The type declares `length` on both faces with `@default 6`, so the read moved and the declaration stayed. Before this change, the published 4-digit and 8-digit examples drew six slots. For `loading`, `LoadingSchema.label` was declared but inert while an undeclared `text` was read. The seat accepted moving the read to `label` over a plain retirement.

**Inputs.** Where a registration published a retired key as an input, the input goes too:
- `active` on `sidebar-menu-button`;
- the three `drawer` keys;
- `modal` on `popover` and on `sheet`.

`dropdown-menu` never published `modal`. `sheet`'s `defaultProps` also loses its `modal` seed. `list`'s `title` input stays.

**An independent instrument.** `pnpm check:component-surface-parity` (objectui#4631, report-only) was read at base `770cc5ba4` in a detached control worktree, and again at the head:
- `interface-missing-key` falls from 59 to 49. The ten rows that go are exactly these keys; `list.title` goes because it is declared now.
- `interface-extra-key` falls from 121 to 120, because `input-otp.length` is now read.
- The total falls from 250 to 239.

## P1 measurement (H1)

The un-chained recipe is `tsc --noEmit`, then `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`. It ran with objectui#8347's mutation applied through `ablation-replace`, and with `@object-ui/types` rebuilt. The restore was proven after every run:
- the blob equals HEAD;
- `git diff HEAD` on `base.ts` is empty;
- the dist index-signature count is back to 2.

| tree | src program | test program |
|---|---|---|
| base `770cc5ba4`, mutated | 12 | 106 (12 of them the same source sites, so 94 test errors in 20 files) |
| head `61be40730`, mutated | **0**, so the two `list` reads compile against `ListSchema.title` | **30** |
| base and head, signature present (control) | 0 | 0 |

## The tests (H4)

64 literals are now typed as the nodes they are, each through a small typed identity per file (`actionBar`, `textNode`, `selectNode`, ...). Excess-property checking therefore runs against the concrete type, not against `BaseSchema`. The helpers are not generic, so they cannot widen anything. The button variant and size tables and the input `inputType` table are typed with the declared unions.

`list-title-declared-11347.test.tsx` pins `list.title` on three readers:
- **The runtime.** The guide's own literal, rendered through the real `SchemaRenderer`, draws `Team` as the heading. A list with no title draws none.
- **The zod mirror.** A string parses, and a number is refused at `title`.
- **The compiler.** A `@ts-expect-error` sits on a numeric `title`, and `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` reads it.

The 30 left, by file:
- **objectui#8347's probe flip (1):** `form-renderers.test.tsx`, where `label` authors its retired `content` spelling on purpose.
- **No TypeScript node type exists (29); the seat moved these to objectui#11364:**
  - The `properties` bag of `element:text`, `element:text_input` and `element:record_picker`:
    - `page-variables.test.tsx` (5, one of them `dataSource`)
    - `text-input.test.tsx` (5)
    - `text-input-description-association.test.tsx` (1)
    - `required-marker-markup.test.tsx` (1)
    - `record-picker-label-association.test.tsx` (1)
  - `items` on `page:tabs`: `page-tabs-builtin-label-i18n-4645.test.tsx` (2) and `chrome-i18n-no-provider-fallback.test.tsx` (1).
  - The executor keys of `action:button`: `action-params-templates-7867.test.tsx` (5).
  - The page kind `home` with `kind`: `html-page-lazy-blocks.test.tsx` (1) and `react-page-scope.test.tsx` (1).
  - The legacy `props` alias: `alias-precedence-cross-channel.test.tsx` (4).
  - A type that only the test registers, with `properties`: `degenerate-config-bag.test.tsx` (2).

## Files outside the claimed surface

Each was forced by a verdict, and the at-tier record judged each one.
- `packages/types/src/crud.ts`: the `CRUDDialogSchema.showClose` docblock no longer names the drawer's retired look-alike read as live.
- `packages/types/src/__tests__/layout-default-jsdoc-7361.test.ts`: the test now pins that retirement, with a firing control.
- `packages/components/src/renderers/__tests__/node-slot-numeric-falsy.test.tsx`: the `drawer footer` row is removed.
- `.changeset/8318-jsdoc-default-tag-corrections.md`: a dated correction is appended, and the frontmatter is byte-identical.
  - `changeset-claim-re-read` flagged `renderers/overlay/drawer.tsx:38` in this changeset. That address sits in the original bullet, inside the append-only prefix.
  - In round 2 the appended correction binds the same address, in its own sentence, to `33f4a1980`, the commit that added this changeset. I read that tree through a REST contents read, and line 38 there is the `drawer` registration's `showClose` read. The correction also names that read by what it is.
  - The prefix occurrence stays unbound, because editing it would break append-only. The first 2879 bytes are byte-identical to `origin/main` (`cmp -n 2879` exits 0). The gate still reports the prefix occurrence, which is report-only.

The branch merges cleanly with `origin/main` (`git merge-tree` exit 0).

## Gates

The PR head is `57c757ffa`. It differs from `61be40730` by one `.changeset/*.md` file and touches no TypeScript program.


- **Build:**
  - At `61be40730`: `pnpm --filter '@object-ui/components^...' build` exits 0.
  - At `57c757ffa`: the scoped `turbo run build` that `check:skill-examples --build-filter` names succeeds on all 29 tasks.
- **Type check:** at `61be40730`, `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types type-check` and `pnpm --filter @object-ui/components type-check` both exit 0, with 0 `error TS` lines. That run also consumes the new pin's `@ts-expect-error`.
- **Tests:**
  - At `61be40730`: `vitest run packages/types/` + the new pin passed 310 files and 7822 tests.
  - At `57c757ffa`: `vitest run packages/components/` gave 349 files passed and 1 skipped (350); 3481 tests passed and 24 skipped; the lock reported VERDICT command-exit 0.
  - Round 1, at `bba957503`: `examples/schema-catalog/` + `widget-dom-leak-sweep` + `registry-inputs-spec-parity` passed 38 files and 2677 tests.
- **`check:skill-examples`** at `57c757ffa` exits 0 after the scoped build: 18 of 18 ts fences are judged with 0 failed, 70 json fences parse with 0 failed, and the gate reports "Every marked skill example holds up against the built types."
- **Other checks:**
  - Exit 0: `check:new-line-citations`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:changeset-claims` (report-only; see the note below), `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:doc-types`, `check:doc-fences`, `check:doc-example-ids`, `check:component-surface-parity`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:self-import`, `check:prompt-keys`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `check:skills-paths`, changeset presence and no-major.
  - `check-governed-queue-guard --test` reads NOT GOVERNED.
- **Pending changesets.** I re-read every pending changeset the gate lists as naming this round's surface (`list.tsx`, `drawer.tsx`, `data-display.ts`, `data-display.zod.ts`). There are 13 of them: 5926, 6349 batch 1, 6881, 6940, 6951, 6972, 7352, 7694, 7722, 8331, 8478, 9256-list, and the 5350 table one. 8318 is flagged separately, by its line address. None is made false by this branch except 8318, which carries the correction.
  - 7722 says the `list` renderer reads `wrapperClass` and that the key was undeclared; both still hold.
  - 9256-list says no `body` / `children` read files under `ListSchema`; that still holds.
  - 8478's `.describe()` strings gain no line address.
  - The other ten are about different members.
- **Narrowed lint (round 1):** the 28 touched `.ts`/`.tsx` files gave 0 errors and 73 warnings, against the same 0 and 73 for those files at base. Type-aware linting is off and no custom rule reads the disk, so the narrowed run speaks for the untouched files too. Round 2 adds one test file, which CI's `Lint` reads.

## Acceptance notes (observed, not filed)

- **The prop spread.** `SchemaRenderer` still spreads unread node keys onto the component. An authored `modal` or `shouldScaleBackground` therefore still reaches the Radix or vaul root. An authored `title` on a list also lands as a DOM `title` attribute on the `ol`/`ul`, and `text` / `label` on `loading` land on its wrapper. These belong to the strict face (objectui#8345, objectui#11070) and to the bare-spread family.
- **Family consistency.** `DialogSchema` and `ContextMenuSchema` declare `modal`, and `SheetSchema` and `DialogSchema` declare `footer`. Rule 3 retires the same keys on these four nodes, because no producer authors them there.
- **`LoadingSchema.size`.** The declared union is `'sm' | 'default' | 'lg'`, and the renderer branches on `sm` / `md` / `lg` / `xl`. NOT MEASURED, carried for the next touch.
- **`input-otp` `separator`** draws nothing. It is filed as objectui#11365.
